full.description: This image is a clinical photograph of a newborn infant at 24 weeks gestation, presenting with a typical grotesque appearance characteristic of generalized lymphangiomatosis. The fetus displays widespread cutaneous and subcutaneous edema with marked shiny skin changes. There are associated limb and facial abnormalities visible due to lymphatic system malformations. The infant is a macerated stillborn resulting from this severe congenital condition.

random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a newborn infant with severe dermatological manifestations. The baby's skin is encased in thick, tight, parchment-like plates separated by deep, erythematous fissures. The infant exhibits characteristic features of harlequin ichthyosis, a severe genetic skin disorder. Severe ectropion and eclabium are also visible on the face.
